Enterprise Edition.note: Existing strings render it as 'Enterprise sürümü' when 'Edition' is generic ('Enterprise Edition License' -> 'Enterprise sürümü lisansı'); keep the product name itself in English.

Team Edition.note: Existing strings use 'Team sürümü' in running text; keep 'Team' in English, never translate it as 'Takım' here.

Channels.note: Product name; do not confuse with the common noun 'channel' = 'kanal'.

Playbooks.note: Product name; the common noun 'playbook' is 'senaryo' in the Playbooks plugin.

Calls.note: Product name; the common noun 'call' is 'çağrı'.

SSO.note: Spelled out as 'tek oturum açma' in explanatory text; keep the abbreviation in labels.

MFA.note: Spelled out as 'çok aşamalı kimlik doğrulama' in explanatory text; keep the abbreviation in labels.

System Console.note: Consistently 'sistem panosu' in existing translations (not 'sistem konsolu'). Capitalize only sentence-initially; Turkish UI text here uses sentence case.

post.note: Turkish uses 'ileti' for both 'post' and 'message'; existing translations do not distinguish them.

thread.note: Majority rendering is 'konu'; a few mobile strings use 'ileti dizisi' — prefer 'konu'. Threads view = 'Konular'.

reply.note: Noun: 'yanıt'; verb (buttons): 'yanıtla'. Turkish buttons use imperative verb forms.

direct message.note: Do not use 'özel mesaj'; 'DM' is spelled out.

mention.note: Noun: 'anma'; verb: 'anmak' (e.g. 'yalnızca anıldığınızda' = 'only when mentioned'). '@mention' = '@anma'. Do not use 'bahsetme'.

bookmark.note: Noun: 'yer imi'; verb phrase: 'yer imi ekle'.

emoji.note: Long-standing repo convention; do not use the loanword 'emoji' to stay consistent with existing UI.

do not disturb.note: Sentence case in UI: 'Rahatsız etmeyin'. 'DND' is spelled out.

online.note: Written as two words per repo convention (TDK spelling), not 'çevrimiçi'.

session.note: Same root as sign-in ('oturum aç'); context disambiguates.

sign in.note: Both 'sign in' and 'log in' are 'oturum aç' throughout; imperative for buttons ('Oturum aç'), 'oturum açın' in instructions.

sign out.note: Both 'sign out' and 'log out' are 'oturumu kapat'.

mute.note: For channels/categories the repo renders mute as 'bildirimleri kapat' (turn off notifications), e.g. 'Mute Channel' = 'Kanal bildirimlerini kapat'; 'unmute' = 'bildirimleri aç'. Distinct from Calls microphone mute = 'sesi kapat'.

follow.note: Verb 'izlemek' ('Konuyu izle'); mobile occasionally uses 'takip et' — prefer 'izle' for consistency.

favorite.note: Core apps: 'Favorite' = 'Beğendiklerime ekle', 'Favorites' category = 'Beğendiklerim', 'Unfavorite' = 'Beğendiklerimden kaldır'. Playbooks inconsistently uses 'sık kullanılanlar' — the core 'beğen-' family is the majority rendering.

webhook.note: Repo consistently localizes webhook as 'internet kancası'; do not keep English 'webhook'.

trial.note: 'free trial' = 'ücretsiz deneme'; 'trial period' often rendered 'deneme süresi'.

deactivate.note: Webapp (user-facing) uses 'etkisizleştir' for accounts; server strings sometimes use 'kullanımdan kaldır' (also used for disabling features). Prefer 'etkisizleştir' for user accounts.

invite.note: Verb: 'davet et'; noun: 'davet' ('Davet kodu' = invite code).

shared channel.note: Both 'paylaşılan kanal' and 'paylaşılmış kanal' appear; 'paylaşılan kanal' is the majority.

recap.note: No existing tr strings for this feature yet; 'özet' matches Turkish UI convention for AI summaries. If it must be distinguished from a plain 'summary' in the same view, 'etkinlik özeti' is a safe longer form.

agent.note: Existing webapp/mobile strings use 'aracı' (e.g. 'Aracıyı seçin', 'yapay zeka aracısı'). Beware case suffixes: accusative 'aracıyı'. Despite the homonym meaning 'intermediary', keep 'aracı' for consistency.

burn-on-read.note: Established as 'okunduğunda yok edilecek ileti(ler)' for burn-on-read messages; the bare label 'Burn-on-read' = 'Okunduğunda yok edilecek'.

personal access token.note: Repo renders 'token' as 'kod' in this term (not 'jeton'/'belirteç').

announcement banner.note: Existing strings are inconsistent ('Duyuru bildirimi', plain 'bildirim'). 'duyuru bildirimi' is the labeled form; 'duyuru şeridi' would be clearer but is not established.

channel banner.note: Webapp majority is 'kanal bildirimi'; server strings use 'kanal duyurusu', which is arguably clearer (avoids collision with notifications) — flag for future harmonization.

display name.note: Repo uses the future participle 'görüntülenecek ad' (name to be displayed), not 'görünen ad'.

data retention.note: 'data retention policy' = 'verileri tutma ilkesi'. Some strings use 'veri tutma'; majority is 'verileri tutma'. 'policy' = 'ilke' (not 'politika').

access control.note: 'attribute-based access control (ABAC)' = 'öznitelik temelli erişim denetimi'; 'access control policy' = 'erişim denetimi ilkesi'.

onboarding.note: Repo renders onboarding descriptively as 'başlamaya hazırlanma / başlamaya hazırlık'; no loanword.

Town Square.note: Established default-channel name in server i18n; keep exactly 'Meydan'.

Off-Topic.note: Established default-channel name in server i18n.

server.note: Beware: the Calls plugin also uses 'sunucu' for the call host; in core/server contexts 'sunucu' always means server.
